Based on Article 3 of the Law on Digital Technology Industry, the Digital technology industry is defined as:

"A foundation industry, a high-tech economic and technical industry that creates digital technology products and services with high added value, affecting many industries and fields."

This definition indicates that it's not just a single sector but rather a foundational and cross-cutting industry that impacts multiple areas of the economy. The law further specifies in Article 2 that this industry includes agencies, organizations, and individuals involved in or related to digital technology activities.

The context also shows that this industry is closely tied to digital transformation and innovation across various fields, utilizing technologies such as artificial intelligence, big data, cloud computing, internet of things, blockchain, and virtual/augmented reality.
